verdict.rationale: Copilot documents its own Connectors feature for linking the assistant to other services. The list includes third-party Google services (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Contacts) alongside OneDrive and Outlook.com, available on Copilot.com and mobile. However, this is a small fixed set of first-party and Google connectors, not a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps. Missing for 10: a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps, a breadth of connectors beyond a handful of services, documentation of the browse-and-add flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
